lines.text: The descendants of Judah include Perez, Hezron, and Hur, and Ashhur the father of Tekoa had two wives.
Jabez called out to the God of Israel to bless him and enlarge his territory, and God granted his request.
Shimei had twelve sons and six daughters, but his brothers did not have many children.
The Simeonites sought pasture at Gedor, and in Hezekiah's days they attacked the Hamites and settled there.
Five hundred Simeonites went to Mount Carmel and struck down the remnant of the Amalekites who had escaped.
